_comment: Every entry is a triple: behavior, verification command, state. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. Granularity: each feature should be completable in one session.

features.name: Full-pipeline smoke run produces a valid AVS on a live model
features.behavior: Running evaluation.py with HybridACDForecaster on 5 scraped-tuple questions against a real model API exits 0 and stats_summary.json contains a non-null AVS field.
features.verification: python src/evaluation.py --tuple_dir src/data/tuples/scraped --num_lines 5 --run --async -k all -p src/forecasters/hybrid_acd_forecaster.py::HybridACDForecaster -o model=levuphong2909/gpt-5.6-luna -o research_enabled=False --output_dir src/data/forecasts/_smoke_run
features.evidence: Executed evaluation.py across all 10 consistency checkers on num_lines=5 (50 tuples) with HybridACDForecaster (model=levuphong2909/gpt-5.6-luna, adversarial_enabled=True, tcd_enabled=True, research_enabled=False). Command exited 0 and produced src/data/forecasts/_smoke_run/stats_summary.json with valid AVS metrics (avg_violation: 0.0 across all checkers). Raw JSONL traces verified for interval checkers (AndChecker, OrChecker, CondChecker, CondCondChecker) confirming rich, date-accurate chain-of-thought reasoning and non-degenerate Fréchet bound enforcement.

features.behavior: Paper flags increased Calibration Error on Mistral-Medium-3.5 and Mistral-Small-4 after HybridACD as unresolved ('†'). Investigate whether narrower [l,u] intervals correlate with the regression, propose a soft-penalty alternative to hard clipping.

features.name: Retrieval-augmented small-model forecasting
features.behavior: Add a pre-elicitation retrieval step (news/context search) to HybridACDForecaster, run before adversarial rewrite + TCD, with a hard date-cutoff filter enforced AT THE SEARCH-PROVIDER API LEVEL per question (never as prompt text alone — proven insufficient, see evidence) to prevent outcome leakage on already-resolved tuple sets (e.g. src/data/tuples/scraped). Hypothesis: a small model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini or smaller) with clean, leakage-free retrieval closes most of the Brier-score gap to a large model without retrieval, while TCD keeps AVS low regardless of model size or retrieval.
features.verification: Non-retrieval baselines already exist on disk (confirmed 2026-08-23) — no fresh runs needed: small = BasicForecaster_gpt4o_mini_2024-07-18_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.202, CE 0.142; tuples_scraped AVS 0.0300 default / 0.1874 freq); large = BasicForecaster_gpt4o_2024-08-06_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.179, CE 0.065) or CoT_ForecasterTextBeforeParsing_o1-preview_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.168). ResolverBasedForecaster_llama-3.1-sonar-large-128k_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.096) is CONFIRMED UNUSABLE as an upper-bound reference (see evidence) — do not cite it in any comparison table. Before implementation: select a search provider with a verified absolute end-date parameter (e.g. Tavily end_date, Exa end_published_date, Bing News date-range) per ADR-003 — check that provider's current docs directly, do not assume. Then run the treatment (HybridACDForecaster + audited-clean retrieval, small model, num_lines=5 smoke scale first) and report against the two disk baselines above in one table per docs/conventions.md baseline-first rule. Falsifiable prediction to state before running: Brier(small+retrieval) should land closer to Brier(large, no-retrieval) than to Brier(small, no-retrieval); if not, that's the finding.
features.evidence: Audited 2026-08-23: ResolverBasedForecaster (src/forecasters/various.py) passes created_date/resolution_date into the prompt as plain text only (src/perplexity_resolver/prompts.py); no date parameter reaches the actual Perplexity API call (src/common/perplexity_client.py::_prepare_payload sends no search_recency_filter or equivalent). Perplexity's search_recency_filter is relative-only (month/week/day/hour) and cannot express an absolute historical cutoff at all, even if wired up. Result: its live search returns post-resolution news for the already-resolved scraped set, the model reads the outcome off those articles, and reports can_resolve_question=True with p in {0.001, 0.999} — confirmed outcome leakage, not forecasting. Its 0.096/0.088 Brier scores are excluded as an F007 reference. Full ADR in DECISIONS.md ADR-003.
features.blocked_by: F003 (smoke run harness must be proven working before adding a retrieval step to it); search-provider selection with a verified absolute date-cutoff parameter (see verification)
